text:
alex: Heads up — KestrelSec pen test scheduled Wed 2026-05-06 09:00 PST (4h window). Scope: infra + private deploys. No customer PII in scope. Need to lock down RBAC changes, KMS access, and audit log retention before the start. I attached the scope PDF and a short checklist.

maya: thanks. quick Q — will assessors need `kms:Decrypt` or just upload ability to S3?

devon: prefer presigned uploads + server-side encryption (SSE-KMS) so we avoid granting decrypt permissions. assessors can still validate artifacts without decrypt.

alex: agreed. plan is presigned S3 PUT with header `x-amz-server-side-encryption: aws:kms` using alias `alias/redwood-pt-evidence`. ops will rotate the key after the window.

maya: for RBAC: we should create an ephemeral role with timeboxed STS creds scoped to `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pt-assessor` and restrict to s3:PutObject + s3:ListBucket + sts:AssumeRole. who can approve that role?

jamie: i'll own evidence packaging and presigned URL flow. alex can you create the role and tag it `pt:assessor=true` so we can filter in CloudTrail?

alex: yes — creating role now. policy snippet I'm going to use:```json
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[{
    "Effect":"Allow",
    "Action":["s3:PutObject","s3:ListBucket"],
    "Resource":["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-evidence/*","arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-evidence"]
  }]
}
```

devon: add condition to limit by `aws:RequestTag/pt-assessment` and `aws:TagKeys` to prevent reuse. also log `s3:ObjectCreated:*` to a dedicated `pt-audit` bucket.

security-bot: CHECKLIST: 1) Ephemeral assessor role created with STS TTL <= 4h. 2) KMS alias `alias/redwood-pt-evidence` created and key policy restricts decrypt to internal ops only. 3) Presigned PUT flow validated. 4) CloudTrail and S3 access logs enabled -> retention 90d. 5) Evidence upload playbook shared with assessor.

maya: on audit logs — do we need to forward to SIEM in real time or can we do post-window ingestion? customer/regulator asks for immutable stream.

ops: forward S3 and CloudTrail to SIEM (logs-redwood) with Kinesis Firehose. We'll also snapshot the `pt-audit` bucket daily and write WORM object lock for 180 days for immutability.

jamie: reminder: do not share any manager creds in the drive link. use the secure evidence page: https://internal.redwood/evidence-upload (will generate presigned).

alex: remediation tracker — i'll create a lightweight GH project and a CSV export for assessors to attach PoC screenshots. tagging convention `pt-<ticketid>`. jamie please triage incoming uploads into the tracker.

jamie: on it. i'll also add a column for `evidence_object_key` and `kms_key_alias` so we can trace items back to the key.

devon: for retest coordination — propose we schedule a 30m dry-run 24h before to validate presigned flow and roles. who from infra can join?

oncall-bot: @devon scheduled dry-run: Tue 2026-05-05 09:00 PST. Invitees: devon, alex, jamie, ops.

alex: dry-run confirmed. please exercise: 1) assume role -> 2) generate presigned PUT -> 3) upload sample artifact -> 4) confirm CloudTrail entry and S3 inventory.

maya: small gotcha — ensure KMS key grants don't include `kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext` to assessors. if they can generate data keys we leak plaintext.

ops: noted — key policy will only allow `kms:Encrypt` from presigned path and `kms:Decrypt` is reserved for ops service principal.

security-bot: ACTIONS ASSIGNED: alex -> create role + GH tracker; ops -> KMS alias + key policy + Firehose to SIEM; jamie -> evidence playbook + triage; devon -> run dry-run and validate CloudTrail entries.

alex: i'll post the role ARNs and the tracker link in this thread once created. tagging @maya for final sign-off on scope.

maya: sign-off pending dry-run success. :thumbsup:

jamie: any special handling for vulnerability findings that reference specific keys/objects? we should redact object keys in public reports.

devon: yes — redact S3 object keys in external-facing reports and reference tracker IDs instead. internal teams can link to the tracker for full object_key.

security-bot: NOTE: ensure all remediation PRs reference the GH tracker ID for auditability.

alex: thanks everyone. i'll follow up with the role ARN and the presigned flow checklist in ~30m.

oncall-bot: Reminder 1h before dry-run.
